scope: Targeted checks, not an exhaustive novelty review

sources.title: Why Language Models Hallucinate
sources.verified_claim: Common benchmark scoring rewards guessing; the authors propose adjusting evaluation incentives to acknowledge uncertainty.

sources.title: Alignment Pretraining: AI Discourse Causes Self-Fulfilling (Mis)alignment
sources.verified_claim: Changing the prevalence of AI alignment/misalignment discourse during pretraining changes downstream alignment behavior.
sources.use: Related work; pretraining-caution connection explicitly a hypothesis

sources.title: Training large language models on narrow tasks can lead to broad misalignment
sources.verified_claim: A narrow insecure-code fine-tuning task can induce broader misaligned behavior.
sources.use: Broader behavioral transfer; does not equate this study with emergent misalignment
